record.paper_title: Some Open Problems Concerning Orthogonal Polynomials on Fractals and Related Questions
record.context_brief: Zero spacing, Green function, Markov factors
record.original_question: Let K be a non-polar compact subset of the real line, let μ_K denote its equilibrium measure, let P_n(·; μ_K) be the nth monic orthogonal polynomial for μ_K, let Z_n(μ_K) be the zero set of P_n(·; μ_K), and let U_n(μ_K) = inf{|x - x'| : x ≠ x' and x, x' ∈ Z_n(μ_K)} be the minimal spacing between distinct zeros. Is there a general relationship between this zero spacing and the smoothness of the Green function g_{C\K}? Is there also a general relationship between the zero spacing for μ_K and the Markov factors associated with K?

evidence.quote: For a measure μ on R, let Zn(μ) := {x : Pn(x; μ) = 0}, Un(μ) := inf_{x ≠ x' ∈ Zn(μ)} |x - x'|.

Problem 6. Let K be a non-polar compact subset of R. Is there a general relation between the zero spacing of orthogonal polynomials for μ_K and smoothness of g_{C\K}? Is there a relation between the zero spacing of μ_K and the Markov factors?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K \subset \mathbb{R}$ be a non-polar compact set (i.e. its logarithmic capacity satisfies $\mathrm{cap}(K) > 0$), and let $\mu_K$ denote the equilibrium measure of $K$ (the unique Borel probability measure on $K$ minimizing the logarithmic energy $\iint \log\frac{1}{|x-y|}\,d\mu(x)\,d\mu(y)$). For each $n \geq 1$, let $P_n(\,\cdot\,;\mu_K)$ denote the $n$-th monic orthogonal polynomial associated with $\mu_K$, defined by $\int x^k P_n(x;\mu_K)\,d\mu_K(x) = 0$ for $0 \leq k < n$. The zeros of $P_n(\,\cdot\,;\mu_K)$ are real and simple; let
$$Z_n(\mu_K) = \{x \in \mathbb{R} : P_n(x;\mu_K) = 0\}, \qquad U_n(\mu_K) = \inf\{|x - x'| : x \neq x',\ x,x' \in Z_n(\mu_K)\}$$
be the zero set and the minimal spacing between distinct zeros, respectively. Let $g_{\mathbb{C}\setminus K}$ denote the Green function of the unbounded component of $\mathbb{C}\setminus K$ with logarithmic pole at infinity, extended by $0$ on $K$. The $n$-th Markov factor of $K$ is
$$M_n(K) = \sup\Bigl\{ \tfrac{\|P'\|_{L^\infty(K)}}{\|P\|_{L^\infty(K)}} : P \text{ a polynomial of degree} \leq n,\ P \not\equiv 0 \Bigr\}.$$

Establish a general quantitative relationship between the zero spacing $U_n(\mu_K)$ and the smoothness (modulus of continuity) of the Green function $g_{\mathbb{C}\setminus K}$. Likewise, establish a general quantitative relationship between $U_n(\mu_K)$ and the Markov factors $M_n(K)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Available literature treats zero spacing, Green-function smoothness, and Markov factors on non-polar compact sets (especially Cantor-type sets) with partial results, but no general quantitative relationship valid for all non-polar compact $K \subset \mathbb{R}$ appears to have been established. The problem appears to remain open in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Orthogonal polynomials for the weakly equilibrium Cantor sets
status_evidence.snippet: Studies spacing of zeros of orthogonal polynomials on specific Cantor-type sets via polynomial mappings; partial, set-specific results.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial/special-case results are available, not a general theorem.

status_evidence.title: Markov-type inequalities and extreme zeros of orthogonal polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates relations between Markov-type inequalities and zeros of orthogonal polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: Connections between Markov factors and zeros are studied but not in full generality for arbitrary non-polar compact K.

status_evidence.title: Unbounded Widom factors for orthogonal and residual polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work on Widom/Markov-type factors and Green-function comparisons for orthogonal polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: Active research, suggesting the general question remains under investigation.
